candidates.DUAL_AND_LONG_CASH: Exposure at month t is 1 only if both SMA10 and MOM12 are positive.
candidates.DUAL_OR_LONG_CASH: Exposure at month t is 1 if either SMA10 or MOM12 is positive.
candidates.MOM12_LONG_CASH: Exposure at month t is 1 only if prior 12-month total return is positive.
candidates.SMA10_LONG_CASH: Exposure at month t is 1 only if prior-month close exceeds prior-month 10-month SMA.

claim_limit: A passing result supports only a monthly US broad-equity exposure reduction gate. It does not prove exact daily crash timing, ticker alpha, shorting, or cross-market transportability.

data.return_formula: (P_t + annual_dividend_t/12)/P_{t-1} - 1; cash return conservatively fixed at zero.
data.source: datasets/s-and-p-500 GitHub mirror generated from Robert Shiller/FRED source chain
data.usable_end_rule: Last month with positive SP500 price and positive dividend; later zero-filled fundamentals excluded.
